name: Denmark
visaRequirements: Schengen Visa required for most non-EU citizens
currency: Danish Krone (DKK) — Denmark is in the EU but not the Eurozone
bestExperience: Best experience: going inside Christiansborg Palace, with the Royal Treasury at Rosenborg a close second.

about.description: Denmark is the smallest and flattest of the Nordic countries, and the easiest to travel in. Copenhagen sits on the east coast of Zealand, a short train ride from Sweden across the Øresund bridge, and is compact enough to cover on foot and by bike.
highlights: Nyhavn and the old harbour, best seen from a canal cruise
Christiansborg — parliament, supreme court and royal palace in one building
The Royal Treasury and crown jewels beneath Rosenborg Castle
Tivoli Gardens, at its best after dark at Christmas
Compact enough to cover properly in two days on foot

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: May to September for long days and outdoor life; December for the Christmas markets
transportation: Copenhagen Metro runs 24 hours and connects the airport to the centre in about 15 minutes
Cycling is the default way to get around the city
Trains to the rest of Denmark and across to Sweden leave from København H
culturalNotes: Card payment is accepted essentially everywhere — you can visit without cash
Tap water is safe and free at restaurants
Tipping is not expected; service is included
Cycle lanes are real roads — check before stepping into one
